svg.title: Hook latency, p50 and p95, against budgets
svg.desc: Non-install command 121 ms p50 and 177 ms p95 (budget 238 ms including Node start); one install warm 358 / 372 ms (budget 1 s); one install cold 2.4 / 3.7 s (budget 5 s).
